notes: 0.5 mm pitch with 0.25 mm lands cannot pass a 0.09 mm trace with 0.09 mm spacing on both sides.
Filled and capped via-in-pad is an option on multilayers; the example uses 0.15/0.25 mm but the later recommendation prefers outer diameter at least 0.35 mm.
Few 0.076 mm traces are described as possible; pad-to-trace clearance and order-specific process still need confirmation.

decision: Keep standard geometry outside BGA; do not infer fabrication approval for fine-pitch escapes from DRC. Resolve pad clearance, annular ring, filling/capping, stackup and surcharge before release.
